parts.t: Royal Heights is a small hilltop neighbourhood on the west side of North Surrey, just off Scott Road and above the Fraser. It's mostly detached houses on quiet, curving streets, and listings here don't come up often. This page shows what's for sale in Royal Heights now.

Quick intro: I'm a REALTOR® licensed since 2015, with more than $500M in sales. I'm in the Top 1% of Fraser Valley REALTORS®, and I take the same careful approach to small neighbourhoods like this one. Read my
Royal Heights neighbourhood guide
or compare all
North Surrey homes for sale
Written by
Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®

Royal Heights Park, at 9797 115A Street, is about 2.2 hectares and sits in the middle of the neighbourhood. Royal Heights Elementary is on 97 Avenue and is in the L.A. Matheson Secondary family. Check any address in the Surrey Schools School Locator.
The R6 RapidBus and route 319 run along Scott Road, and route 314 runs on 96 Avenue. Scott Road SkyTrain Station is a short bus ride north.
Part of Royal Heights was in a site-specific CD zone that has been rezoned to R3. Zoning can differ from one lot to the next, so look the lot up in the City's COSMOS map before you plan changes. My
Surrey zoning guide
explains the zones.

Royal Heights suits buyers who want a quiet street of houses, a park in the middle of the neighbourhood, and quick access to Scott Road for buses and shops. Because it's small, there's very little through traffic.
It may suit you less if you need lots of choice. Only a few homes come up at a time, so you may have to wait, or watch nearby areas too.

With so few listings, a well-prepared Royal Heights home can get attention from buyers who have been waiting for this area. I'll help you get the zoning, permits and any updates in order so buyers have the facts they need. Then we'll set a price from recent nearby sales.
If you're not in a rush, I can set up an alert for Royal Heights only, so you hear about a new listing the day it's posted.
Drive the streets on a weekday evening and on a Saturday. A small neighbourhood can feel quite different depending on the time.

blocks.text: Is there a park in the neighbourhood?

parts.t: Yes. Royal Heights Park, at 9797 115A Street, is about 2.2 hectares.
Part of the area was rezoned from a CD zone to R3. Look up each lot in COSMOS.
The R6 and 319 on Scott Road, and the 314 on 96 Avenue.
Scott Road has shops and services a short drive or bus ride away. Inside the neighbourhood itself, it is almost all homes.

blocks.text: How often do Royal Heights homes come up for sale?

parts.t: Not often, since it's a small neighbourhood. An alert is the easiest way to catch new listings.
